duplicate_audit.method: 16-sounding-note exact pitch-interval and relative-duration matches; invariant to transposition/uniform duration scaling
duplicate_audit.limit: A heuristic over available excerpts, not complete composition-level deduplication.

notes: Full source PDFs remain in ignored project research storage; repository includes melody excerpts and source metadata only.
No IMSLP CAPTCHA was bypassed. Blocked file pages from the previous investigation were not retried.

Balanced banks were used for a fixed 200-step/member, four-seed CPU trial on all training works and original held-out fold 0. No fold-0 calibration met validation constraints; trial rejected and shipped app model retained. See tool/genre/balance_report.json.

Error-audit follow-up accepted no new independent works. A source-verified Ikaw Rin training replacement corrects approximate triplets but retains the existing work ID; real counts remain 17 training / 4 validation / 2 fresh test. See training_corrections.json and ../error_audit.json.

Later reconciliation/collection follow-up admits eight verified bars of the historical El Cundiman from the acquired UST 1892 scan: 18 train / 4 validation / 2 fresh test. No newly trained replacement model or accuracy gain claimed.
